en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a mid‑20th‑century motor vessel named "HENRIETTE" at sea. The ship has a single mast with rigging, a lifeboat on deck, and a group of people gathered on the aft superstructure. A national flag flies at the stern. At the top right of the card, printed text reads "WATERHUIZEN bij GRONING…". The scene is taken from the water level with open sea in the background.
